spans.s:
m. (-थः)
1 A car, a war-chariot.
2 A car, a carriage in general, any vehicle or mode of conveyance.
3 A limb, a member.
4 The body.
5 A foot.
6. A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. क्थन्.

f. (-ट्या)
A multitude of cars.
E.
रथ a car, and कट्यच् aff. of multitude.

m. (-रः)
A carpenter.
E.
रथ a car, and कर who makes; also रथकार and रथकृत्.

m. (-रः)
1 A carpenter.
2 A man sprung from the male of the Māhiṣya, and woman of the Keren or writer caste; by profession, a maker of cars, a coach-maker.
E.
रथ a car, and कार who makes.

m. (-म्बी)
A charioteer.
E.
रथ a car, and कुटुम्बिन who takes care of as a part of his family.

m. (-कः)
A car or litter borne on men's shoulders.
E.
रथ a car, गर्भ an embryo, and कन् aff.

f. (-प्तिः)
A piece of wood, or an iron net-work, encompassing a war-chariot, to secure it from being injured by weapons or collision.
E.
रथ car, and गुप्ति screening, preserving; also रथगोपन n. (-नं).

m. (-णः)
The ruddy goose.
E.
रथ a car, and चरण the foot.

m. (-द्रुः)
A timber tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.)
E.
रथ a car, and द्रु the tree, the wood being used for wheels, &c.; also रथद्रुम m. (-मः).

n. (-रं)
The Sāma Veda.
E.
रथ (as by) a car, तॄ to pass (the world), खच् aff.

m. (-यः)
A sort of cane, the ratan.
E.
रथ a car, and पर्य्याय order.

m. (-दः)
1 A wheel.
2 The ruddy goose.
E.
रथ a car, and पाद the foot.

f. (-प्सा)
The name of a river.

f. (-त्रा)
A festival at which the chariots of the gods go in procession: in Bengal and Orissa it is applied to the procession of the car of KṚṢṆA, as JAGANNĀTHA, on the second of the light fortnight of Āṣārha.
E.
रथ, and यात्रा going.

m. (-कः)
A charioteer.
E.
रथ, and वाहक what conveys.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 A wheel.
2 Any part of a carriage.
m. (-ङ्गः)
The ruddy goose, (Anas casarca.)
E.
रथ a car, अङ्ग a member.

m. (-णिः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
रथाङ्ग a wheel, (the discus with which one of his, hands is armed,) and पाणि the hand; also रथाङ्गिन् and the like.

m. (-भ्रः)
A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
रथ the same, and अभ्र a cloud or water.

m. (-ष्पः)
A sort of reed: see the last.
E.
रथाभ्र the same, and पुष्प a flower; also रथ, रथाभ्र, and अभ्रपुष्प.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Mounted on or riding in a car.
E.
रथ, and आरूढ mounted.

n. (-णं)
1 Riding in a car.
2 Fighting in a warchariot.
E.
रथ, and आरोहण mounting.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Riding in a car.
m. (-ही)
A warrior who fights in a car.
E.
रथ a car, and आरोहिन् who mounts.

m. (-कः)
A small car.
E.
रथ, and अर्भक small.

n. (-णं)
Alighting from a car.
E.
रथ, and अवरोहण descending.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Descending from a car.
E.
रथ, and अवरोहिन् who descends.

m. (-कः)
The owner of a car, or one who rides in it.
E.
रथ, and ष्ठन् aff.

m. (-थी)
1 A warrior who fights in a car.
2 The owner of or rider in a car.
E.
रथ, and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
The master of a car.
E.
रथ, and इन a master.

m. (-रः)
The owner of or rider in a car.
E.
रथ, and इरच् aff.

m. (-स्थः)
The charioteer's seat for driving.
E.
रथ, उप near, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-थ्यः)
A car or carriage horse.
f. (-थ्यं)
1 A multitude of cars.
2 A high street.
3 A main or carriage road.
4 A place where several roads meet.
n. (-थ्यं)
A wheel.
E.
रथ a car, and य or यत् affixes of multitude or fitness.
